title: Oeufs Mayonnaise (French Eggs with Lemon Mayonnaise)
summary: Eggs boiled for 10-11 min, chilled and halved, then coated in a hand-whisked mayonnaise made with an egg yolk, mustard powder, lemon juice, garlic and oil. Finished with chives.
equipment: mixing bowl on a damp cloth

ingredients.item: large pasteurised egg yolk, at room temperature
ingredients.note: see the egg-safety note for a cooked-yolk method

ingredients.item: mustard powder mixed with 1 tsp water
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Boil the eggs
steps.text: Lower the eggs into a pan of boiling water and keep it at a steady simmer for 10-11 min so the yolks are firm (71 °C or above). Plunge them into iced water to stop the cooking, then peel and halve lengthways.

steps.title: Start the mayonnaise
steps.text: Set the bowl on a damp cloth so it won't slide. Whisk the yolk, mustard paste, lemon juice, garlic, salt and pepper together until smooth; the mustard and yolk both help hold the sauce together.

steps.title: Emulsify
steps.text: Whisking constantly, add the mixed oils a few drops at a time until the sauce starts to thicken, then pour in a thin, steady stream. If it looks greasy, stop adding oil and whisk until it turns glossy again. Thin with a few drops of warm water until it falls from the spoon in thick ribbons.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Spoon a little mayonnaise onto each plate and set the egg halves on top cut side down. Coat them generously with the rest and scatter with chives.

tips: Have the yolk at room temperature; cold yolks are more likely to split.
If the mayonnaise splits, whisk a fresh yolk in a clean bowl and slowly beat the split sauce back in.
safety: Egg safety: the mayonnaise yolk is raw, so use a pasteurised yolk. Otherwise whisk the yolk with the lemon juice and 1 tbsp water in a heatproof bowl over barely simmering water until it reaches 71 °C and thickens, cool for 5 min, then continue. Pregnant people, young children, older adults and anyone with weakened immunity should skip raw-yolk mayonnaise.
storage: Mayonnaise made with pasteurised or cooked yolk keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Assemble the eggs just before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
